title: Agreement between the Kingdom of Swaziland and the Republic of South Africa relating to the establishment of an office for a Swaziland labour representative in the Republic
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Laws.Africa PDF supplied by IMR: Government Notice 121 of 1975, assented to and commenced on 22 September 1975 (text as at 1 December 1998). The Agreement replaces arrangements in force since 1 July 1963.
